motivation: H4as's privileged-mask attenuation correction recovered88/256 versus129 raw-count graphs. Test a different use of known noise locations: discard pair observations where either cell was corrupted, then infer at the original degree using retained equality counts. The conditional mean correction may introduce variance; this test does not itself isolate variance as the cause.
scope: All256 examined H4an600-row banks and original inferred degrees. Existing observed noisy rows plus the same H4as corruption-location masks; zero new source/label/noise draws or puzzle solves. Unlike H4as's aggregate-count interface, censoring accesses row-aligned observed values. No clean values, actual offsets, truth graph, geometry or true degree enter the scorer. Privileged mask supervision remains explicit.

score.exposure: e_ij = sum_r a_rij, retained as a diagnostic without normalization.
score.integer_cost: c_ij = sum_r a_rij * I(Y_ri=Y_rj). No smoothing, imputation, rate normalization or added penalties. Zero-exposure pairs receive cost0 and remain present; disclose them and their graph outcomes.
score.inference: One unchanged exact common-degree LP per bank at its original H4an inferred degree. Literal half-integral primal and scale-two exact primal/dual proofs; no graph rounding. Selected fractional optima are resolved graph-recovery failures; uncertified LPs unresolved. Same all256-bank denominator.

separate_endpoints.recovery: At least245/256 exact graphs. Lower=exact; upper=exact+unresolved. Support iff lower>=245; falsify iff upper<245; otherwise inconclusive.
separate_endpoints.paired_loss: At most8 lost baseline successes out of the fixed129. Lower=resolved losses; upper adds unresolved baseline-success banks. Support iff upper<=8; falsify iff lower>8; otherwise inconclusive.

correctness_not_endpoint: Under correct corruption masks, uncorrupted observed cells equal their original clean values. Every true exclusion edge therefore has retained equality cost0; the true graph is feasible at the fixed correctly inferred degree, so the LP optimum is0. This is a conditional algebraic property and a provenance invariant, not an empirical success endpoint. It does not imply uniqueness or recovery: other zero-cost regular graphs may tie, and the observed never-equal graph may contain false constraints.
diagnostics: All256 source-level masks/exposures/censored counts, selected outcomes, true-edge nonzero-cost violations, zero-exposure pairs, zero-cost support false/missing edges, zero-cost-support degree distribution, paired gains/losses and exact objective values. Truth-derived diagnostics are evaluated only after fitting and never alter scores or the solver. A provenance invariant violation makes the study incomplete, not a new algorithmic finding.
supervision: The same1382400 privileged corruption-location indices determine12441600 mask entries. Access to already-existing row-aligned noisy observations is additionally required versus H4as's aggregate-count interface. No ordinary observation-only or deployable-noise-detector claim. This is not an oracle-optimal bound.
baseline: Original H4an raw-count selected-degree LP,129/256 exact, hash-bound and every baseline proof rechecked. H4as88/256 and H4ar98/256 are prior examined diagnostics with different scoring information, not newly executed controls. BP AdamW outside this source-only count intervention, explicitly not rerun and first in comparison tables.
gates: Before freeze: synthetic clean/noisy/mask fixtures verify unchanged-cell identity, pair censorship, all/none/mixed corruption and zero exposures; compare independent row/pair loops against final vectorized implementation; vertex/digit permutation parity; positive/zero-cost exact LP proofs; all resolved/unresolved endpoint boundaries; prospective unused solver seed audit. Benchmark candidate count implementations only on unrelated toys and bind final chosen source before any study censored score or LP.
provenance: Freeze all source/archive and prior public hashes before reading study noisy rows for censored scoring. Bind original H4an job mappings. Producer reads only noisy[:600] and cells[:600] from each pinned source archive, never solutions/uniforms/offsets. Independently regenerate original full2400-row corruption selection stream before600 slicing, compare masks, and reconstruct all censored counts/exposures via a different implementation. Hash-bound original noisy values/count provenance remains inherited from parent complete audits, with no claim of recollection.
audit_and_export: Independently reconstruct and verify all256 baseline proofs and available256 new proofs; reject three mutations per valid proof. Preserve every fractional/unresolved bank. Publish observed600-row noisy arrays, corruption indices/masks, exposures/censored scores, all proofs and paired outcomes so the score replay needs no raw parent archives. These are synthetic family data, not official user-provided boards. Public auditor must state that original generation provenance is inherited rather than replaying clean sources.
budget_scope: Input/source hash verification, noisy/mask extraction, censored counts, all LPs, independent bank audits and public export. Preflight and subsequent publication replay separate. Whole-run budget/provenance failure means incomplete, never a reduced-cohort endpoint.
review: Parent and independent design/source review before freeze and study censored-score reads. This proposal contains no new censored-count or LP outcomes.
